annotation.title_clean: Gabinete aprueba la Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Cabinet approves the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Secretaría Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (SENACYT), Panamá
annotation.summary_en: SENACYT news item reporting that Panama's Cabinet approved Resolution No. 89-26 adopting the National AI Strategy. It aims to make Panama a trusted AI innovation hub for Latin America, prioritising local capacity, technological sovereignty, sustainability, international cooperation and investment. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cabinet Resolution No. 89-26 approves Panama's National AI Strategy
Vision: 'Trusted AI Innovation Hub of Latin America'
Priorities: local capacity, technological sovereignty, sustainability, international cooperation, investment
Part of the National Agenda of Advanced Technologies with the Microelectronics and Semiconductors Strategy
Presented by the National Commission for Critical and Emerging Technologies
